title: Trump Posts AI Video of Himself Wrestling Tiger From Fatal Attack
summary:
An AI-edited clip shared by President Trump on Truth Social depicts him pinning and then hugging a tiger that killed a man at a Yorkshire wildlife park. The modified footage alters the original recording of the lethal encounter to portray the president intervening in the attack and wrestling the animal into submission.

The post followed other videos shared on Oct. 13 showing lions and tigers attacking humans, including graphic footage of the British park fatality. Trump amplified the original recording of the man's final moments with the caption "Don’t ever mess with nature! President DJT," in a series of posts that users noted included some AI-generated content.
